title: SAP Data Assurance Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Data Assurance Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Lead the end-to-end SAP data conversion and loading lifecycle, including technical data preparation, conversion, execution of data loads, defect management, and reporting.

Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, developers, and business stakeholders to define test strategies and ensure alignment with project goals.

Coordinate and manage data conversion and data testing cycles.

Ensure traceability between data conversion requirements, test cases, and defects.

Oversee data preparation in coordination with SAP platform, functional and other teams.

Provide leadership and mentorship to other data team members and ensure adherence to data conversion best practices and standards.

Track and report data preparation and conversion progress, risks, and issues to project leadership.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP data conversion, with at least 3 years in a data conversion or related data management role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, etc.) and their integration points.

Experience with SAP S/4HANA data conversion is preferred.

Proficiency in data conversion tools such as ADM by Syniti.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with data conversion tools and frameworks.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid project methodologies.

Knowledge of data conversion tools such as ADM by Syniti.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Desenvolvedor Back-End Java Sr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Software Engineer - Java

Contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Criar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e orientadas ao negócio;
  • Participar ativamente na elaboração das soluções;

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Júnior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


#Requisitos e qualificações:

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

title: Executivo de Vendas Hunter (Varejo) - Remoto
description:
Executivo de Vendas – Mid Market (Varejo) - Salvador

Local: Salvador (Remoto)

Modelo híbrido: 2 dias por semana no escritório


Olá! Obrigado pela sua curiosidade

Somos movidos pela ambição e guiados por uma visão ousada para os próximos anos. À medida que expandimos nossa equipe no Brasil, buscamos um Executivo de Vendas altamente qualificado, independente e apaixonado por vendas e crescimento. Nesta função, você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com nosso Head de Vendas para expandir exponencialmente nossa base de clientes em um território definido. O candidato ideal é proativo, orientado a resultados e apaixonado por vendas e pelo universo da entrega de última milha .


Quem somos

A Zubale é uma empresa de tecnologia que ajuda os varejistas a vencer no e-commerce.

Atendemos uma ampla gama de varejistas — desde supermercados, lojas especializadas, farmácias, lojas de departamento e marcas de moda — em México, Brasil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru e Colômbia. Como fazemos isso?

Temos dois principais produtos:

  • Flexifleet: Marketplace de freelancers para realizar tarefas de picking, packing e delivery para varejistas e agregadores.
  • Consumer Connect: Plataforma de comércio conversacional via WhatsApp com IA para impulsionar vendas e aprimorar a experiência do cliente.

Somos apaixonados por ajudar marcas, agregadores e varejistas a otimizar suas operações de e-commerce, reduzir custos e aumentar a lucratividade.

Com mais de US$ 70 milhões em capital de risco , crescemos de forma consistente nos últimos seis anos e já completamos mais de 150 milhões de pedidos através da nossa plataforma.

Hoje, atendemos mais de 100 clientes e contamos com milhares de freelancers em nossa rede.

E isso é apenas o começo — estamos construindo um ecossistema rentável e escalável , com o objetivo de nos tornarmos o parceiro nº 1 dos varejistas para acelerar seus negócios de e-commerce.


Quem é você

Você é um profissional de vendas orientado a resultados , com mais de 3 anos de experiência comprovada superando metas de forma consistente. Possui um perfil analítico, com forte disciplina na medição e acompanhamento de indicadores para embasar decisões estratégicas.

Tem experiência anterior no setor de varejo , especialmente com supermercados ou aplicativos tipo iFood, Rappi, 99 etc. Gosta de ambientes dinâmicos e está pronto para usar sua experiência para gerar crescimento acelerado de receita .


O que você fará

  • Construir parcerias estratégicas: desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo com tomadores de decisão, aproveitando sua rede de contatos para identificar e conquistar novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Superar objeções: propor soluções criativas e estratégicas para remover barreiras e objeções de clientes, garantindo alta taxa de fechamento.
  • Analisar mercado e concorrência: realizar análises contínuas de mercado e concorrentes para antecipar tendências e ajustar táticas comerciais.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração: alinhar-se de perto com as áreas de Marketing, Produto e Operações para garantir a satisfação do cliente e entregar soluções integradas e personalizadas.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência comprovada em vendas B2B , com histórico de superação de metas.
  • Forte orientação a resultados , com experiência em fechamento e expansão de contas-chave.
  • Domínio de vendas consultivas e baseadas em soluções , com capacidade de entender as necessidades do cliente e propor soluções sob medida.
  • Inglês intermediário para comunicação de negócios.
  • Alta disciplina comercial — gestão estruturada de pipeline, precisão no CRM e acompanhamento rigoroso.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado por dados , capaz de extrair insights e tomar decisões com base em números.
  • Experiência prévia com vendas para supermercados, varejistas ou marketplaces (como iFood, Rappi, 99 ou similares).


O que oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de contribuir com o crescimento de uma empresa em expansão.
  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo e oportunidades de crescimento profissional.
  • Comissões e bônus atrativos.
  • Trabalho híbrido / parcialmente remoto.
  • Plano de desenvolvimento acelerado com base em desempenho.
  • A chance de trabalhar com um time incrível e de alto desempenho.

title: Immigration Paralegal
description:
We are a boutique law firm focused on family immigration matters including but not limited to fiancé visas, family petitions, citizenship, asylum and deportation defense. We practice immigration law throughout the United States, as well as serving individuals abroad seeking to immigrate to the United States. Its founder Michael Mendez has dedicated his practice to solely immigration matters for over 18 years. Our firm culture focuses on individualized client attention, while using the latest technology to assure seamless and effective representation for our clients. As a firm comprised of first and second-generation immigrants, we can relate to the struggles one encounters during the immigration process and thus strive to use our expertise to achieve our clients' immigration goals. Here at Michael Mendez, P.A. we offer compassion, knowledge and the experience needed to attain the American Dream.

We are looking for a licensed attorney in Brazil to join our team to assist Attorney Mendez as well as our U.S. based attorneys and paralegals to communicate with clients directly, analyze, research and draft legal documentation associated with U.S. immigration cases. We are looking for someone who loves working with immigrants as much as we do! A successful candidate will have excellent writing, research and analytical skills to assume responsibility in an active and diverse immigration practice. An applicant must be fluent in English, Spanish. and Portuguese.

Your role will be to serve as a liaison between the attorneys of the firm and the client in order to facilitate a viable immigration application. This role requires excellent communication skills both via email and orally -- it is exceptionally important that we communicate with our clients in both a timely and effective manner. As you gain experience in the U.S. legal process you will have a greater role in devising the strategy to assist the attorneys to obtain approval for our clients.

Strong time management and organizational skills are essential to effectively handle the high-volume of cases with which you will be working. We are looking for an attorney who pays attention to detail, communicates exceptionally, has a positive attitude and strong work ethic. We are looking for someone who values the practice of law with purpose and that desires working at an immigration firm that changes the lives of our clients through innovative thinking and collaborative teamwork.

We are a growing full-service immigration firm that handles all types of family based and deportation defense related U.S. immigration cases

• Licensed Lawyer in Brazil, preferably with a strong focus on writing and research;

• 3+ years legal experience is strongly preferred but not required;

• Fluency in English, Spanish and Portugues.

• Exceptionally strong communication skills;

• Strong research and writing skills;

• Strong organizational skills, detail-oriented, and able to work well under deadlines.

Fully Remote 40 hours per week during standard business hours.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer owns the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and influences the technical direction of their team. They will work closely with Product and Engineering partners in the development of the solution.


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Develop and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and make informed decisions.
  • Employ state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key components of systems and solutions, ensuring that they meet the needs of the business.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders in the development of data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor junior team members to help establish team domain expertise.
  • Contribute to the companys intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Masters Degree or PhD in CS / ML or related field
  • 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design
  • Experience in at least one of these domains: price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection and authentication, marketing
  • Extensive experience in scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)
  • Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure

Fluency in Python, SQL


Preferred Requirements:

  • PhD preferred (CS, ML, AI or related field)
  • Background in applying ML techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused and passionate about delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to lead and inspire a team.

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: HR Manager (on-site, iGaming)
description:
Location: On-site at client offices in Brazil (specific location will be disclosed at interview stage)

Industry: iGaming / Sports Betting (iGaming experience is a mandatory requirement)

Employment Type: Full-time, On-site

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate


About the Role

We're looking for a strategic HR Manager to build and lead the people function for a growing iGaming operation in Brazil. You'll be instrumental in attracting top talent, developing HR infrastructure, and creating a winning culture in this exciting industry.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute comprehensive HR strategies aligned with business objectives
  • Lead full-cycle recruitment for diverse roles across the organization
  • Design and implement onboarding, training, and development programs
  • Manage employee relations, performance management, and retention initiatives
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian labor laws and iGaming regulations
  • Build compensation and benefits structures competitive within the industry
  • Foster a positive organizational culture and employee engagement
  • Handle sensitive matters including conflict resolution and disciplinary actions
  • Implement HR systems and tools to support growing headcount
  • Partner with leadership on workforce planning and organizational design


Requirements

  • Minimum 4 years of HR management experience, with at least 2 years in the iGaming sector
  • Strong knowledge of iGaming industry dynamics, compliance requirements, and talent landscape
  • Proven experience building HR functions in startup or high-growth environments
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)
  • French language skills are a strong advantage
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian labor law and HR best practices
  • Experience with HRIS systems and HR analytics
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or related field
  • HR certification (SHRM, HRCI, or equivalent) is a plus

title: Engenheiro de Software Backend (C# or Node.js) Sênior - Foco em Blockchain
description:
Qual o tamanho dos seus objetivos? Deseja novos desafios?


Então, vem para TQI!


A TQI é uma empresa de tecnologia e inovação que há mais de 30 anos, desenvolve soluções para suportar e alavancar os negócios de seus clientes no Brasil e no exterior.

Com escritórios em Uberlândia (MG) e em São Paulo (SP), e colaboradores em centenas de cidades, a TQI conquistou e mantém há mais de 7 anos o selo Great Place to Work (GPTW), e está no ranking 80+ do GPTW de Tecnologia, reforçando seu compromisso para promover um ambiente diverso e propício para inovação e alta performance.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto


Sobre o projeto:

Você fará parte de uma iniciativa inovadora voltada à criação de soluções digitais que ampliam o acesso de empresas ao mercado financeiro, promovendo inclusão, transparência e eficiência nas relações entre negócios e investidores. O ambiente é dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado à excelência técnica.


O que procuramos:

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend, mensageria, infraestrutura em nuvem e tecnologias blockchain.



Requisitos técnicos:


Essenciais:

  • Experiência com Node.js (Javascript/Typescript) ou C# (.NET Core)
  • Domínio em Apache Kafka para mensageria e streaming de dados
  • Orquestração de containers com Kubernetes e gestão de infraestrutura em AWS
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful e/ou GRPC
  • Forte conhecimento em blockchain privada compatível com EVM (Ethereum, Quorum)
  • Proficiência em Solidity e desenvolvimento de Smart Contracts
  • Experiência com testes automatizados e boas práticas de segurança da informação
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos e trabalhar em equipe


Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Docker , Docker Compose e orquestração com Kubernetes
  • Monitoramento de aplicações com ferramentas como Prometheus , Grafana e APMs
  • Otimização de performance em frontend/backend, incluindo uso de Next.js e SSR (server-side rendering) no React
  • Vivência com automação de pipelines CI/CD avançados
  • Interesse ou experiência com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) e Clean Architecture
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações web , especialmente voltadas ao setor financeiro


O que oferecemos:


Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.


Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!


O time está te esperando, vamos nessa?


#VempraTQI

title: SAP ECC ABAP
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!


Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Procuramos SAP ABAP Consultant que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Temos alguns requisitos:


  • Fluência em inglês é mandatória para uma comunicação eficaz entre equipes globais e stakeholders.
  • Forte desenvolvimento ABAP em objetos RICEF: Relatórios (ALV), Interfaces (IDoc/BAPI/CPI-REST), Conversões (programas LTMC/LSMW/ABAP), Melhorias (BADI/Exits/Enh. Spots) e Formulários (SmartForms/Adobe).
  • ABAP orientado a objetos (OO), modularização, visualizações CDS, conceitos básicos de AMDP, desenvolvimento de serviços BOPF/Fiori OData; sólida depuração e ajuste de desempenho (SQL trace/ST05, SAT/SE30, análise de tempo de execução).
  • Experiência em todo o ciclo de vida: design técnico, construção, testes unitários, revisão de código, gerenciamento de transporte (ChaRM/SolMan) e resolução de defeitos em SIT/UAT/hipercare.
  • Sólido conhecimento de modelos de dados SD/MM/FI e pontos de integração; capacidade de traduzir especificações funcionais em soluções técnicas escaláveis e seguir padrões de codificação.



Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Entregar desenvolvimentos e integrações ABAP de alta qualidade, suportando módulos SAP e necessidades de localização;
  • Fornecer suporte e melhorias na produção.
  • Participar de workshops com equipes funcionais; criar Documentos de Design Técnico (TDD), estimativas e planos de construção.
  • Desenvolver e manter objetos RICEF em conformidade com os padrões de nomenclatura, desempenho e segurança; garantir a reutilização e o tratamento/registro de erros adequado.
  • Construir e expor interfaces via IDoc/BAPI/OData/REST; trabalhar com CPI/PI para mapeamentos de middleware e tratamento de erros.
  • Projetar saídas e formulários: SmartForms/Adobe (S/4 Output Management/BRFplus); lidar com código de barras/QR code e arquivamento em PDF.
  • Implementar melhorias via BADIs/Exits e eventos CDS/BOPF; criar frameworks de AIF/erro, trabalhos em segundo plano e controles de spool/impressão.
  • Realizar testes unitários, criar evidências de teste, oferecer suporte a SIT/UAT e resolver defeitos; manter a rastreabilidade em relação aos requisitos.
  • Otimizar o desempenho usando rastreamento SQL e análise de tempo de execução; Refatorar código personalizado para prontidão S/4HANA (Sintático/Funcional).
  • Gerenciar transportes entre ambientes; cumprir os padrões do Solution Manager/ChaRM e de documentação; oferecer suporte ao hypercare e ao KT para dar suporte às equipes.


O que oferecemos?


Benefícios TCS – Brasil:

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita


Na TATA Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, trabalhamos sempre pela equidade. Isso se aplica em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com esses princípios. Pensamos em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social, a fim de construir uma TCS que respeita a individualidade. Seja um TCSer!

description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Developer / Integration Specialist to support and enhance integrations between Specright PDMS (Salesforce-based) and Interius (Azure-hosted) systems. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Salesforce integrations, API development, and Azure environments. This role focuses primarily on integration development and enhancement , not just application support.

Key Responsibilities

Integration & Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Specright , Interius , and other enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with middleware and infrastructure teams to build and test API connections , handling authentication, performance, and error scenarios.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Salesforce Dataloader scripts and data automation tools.
  • Create and maintain data flow diagrams, mappings, and technical documentation for integrations.
  • Troubleshoot integration and data synchronization issues across Salesforce and Azure environments.

Platform Configuration

  • Configure Specright workflows, templates, and user roles based on business needs.
  • Optimize platform performance and usability.
  • Support supplier onboarding , including portal access and user training.

Application & Technical Support

  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for integration and platform-related incidents.
  • Collaborate with platform vendors and internal IT teams to resolve escalated technical issues.
  • Monitor integration health and performance, identifying improvement opportunities.

Business Analysis & Collaboration

  • Partner with business users to gather and validate integration requirements .
  • Document use cases, functional and technical specifications.
  • Participate in workshops with cross-functional teams (Packaging, Procurement, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support knowledge

title: Language Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training & Evaluation


About the Role:


We are seeking highly skilled Language Specialists to contribute to the training and enhancement of Large Language Models (LLMs). In this role, you will leverage your linguistic expertise to evaluate prompts, rate AI-generated outputs, and create high-quality content that helps refine AI performance. You will play a critical role in shaping the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of AI systems used by global technology leaders.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate prompts and responses generated by AI models to ensure linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance.
  • Serve as a rater by providing structured feedback on AI outputs, identifying errors, biases, or inconsistencies.
  • Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams of linguists, data annotators, and AI researchers.
  • Ensure cultural and linguistic nuances are well-represented in model training.
  • Follow established guidelines while also contributing feedback to improve evaluation frameworks.


Qualifications:


  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Linguistics, Language Studies, Translation, or related field.
  • Strong command of written and spoken language with excellent grammar and stylistic skills.
  • Experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail and ability to identify subtle linguistic issues.
  • Interest in AI, natural language processing (NLP), or large language models is a plus.


Also you need to go through two assessments,so kindly apply only if you will be available for the assessment and ready to collaborate for the project.

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.
  • Travel is required 50-80%.
  • All employees must read, write and speak fluent English and host country language
What ICON Can Offer You
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
Visit our careers website to read more about the benefits of working at ICON: ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.

title: AI Staff Engineer (Remote)
description:
AI Staff EngineerWe are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


You’ll be responsible for empowering users to make the productivity revolution happen in their companies.


As an AI Developer at Pipefy, your mission is to leverage AI to solve user problems proactively! It can be programming a new feature, polishing existing features, supporting a team member, giving feedback, or solving a bug. Your role is crucial in driving our AI capabilities forward.


You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.


Since we are fully remote, you'll meet and work with people from all around the world.


One paragraph resume about what people can expect from working in this position (Mission in the role, responsibilities, seniority and what profile we are looking for).


Main Responsibilities:


- Develop new features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance, as well as improve existing ones, focusing on AI-driven functionalities.

- Take responsibility for the system quality by driving testability together with architects and QAs to ensure that the way we design our platform enables controllability and automation.

- Take responsibility for system stability, ensuring proper testing and observability, actively monitoring production behavior, and reacting quickly to incidents.

- Share knowledge with the team and learn together. We believe knowledge is much more valuable when shared, so we’re always learning and teaching each other.

- Take part in the continuous improvement of Engineering processes, like recruiting, hiring, onboarding, documentation, incidents, tech talks, etc.

- Sought out for technical guidance on your squad and related ones, anticipate technical issues at the product level, and make architectural and design decisions to avoid them.

- Consistently reduce the complexity of projects, systems, and processes to get more done with less work. Breaks up deliverables to optimize for earlier feedback and incremental delivery of business value.

- Help the team develop a more robust engineering culture focused on quality and impactful deliveries by setting an example and mentorship.

- Identify and proactively create projects to fix Pipefy's architecture when preconditions change and current architecture is not optimal/fit anymore, extracting and documenting platforms whenever necessary.


Requirements:


- Write correct, clean code with periodic guidance; consistently follows best practices, including tests (unit, functional, integration).

- Exceptional proficiency in Python, LLM applications and AI model integration.

- Design and develop code to provide an integrated and managed development life cycle for traditional and generative ML applications.

- Experience using LLM-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph and others.

- Experience in implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and working with vector databases.

- Have practical knowledge about infrastructure, service architectures, tools, libraries, frameworks, continuous integration, and continuous deployment systems.

- Able to seamlessly learn and guide others across large sections of our codebase.

- Actively contributes to the technical design of features.

- Understand and make well-reasoned design tradeoffs in their area.

- Strong ability with RESTful.


Bonus point:


- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs.

- Infrastructure: Cloud Computing, AWS, Networks, Load Balancers, Web Servers, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Monitoring.

- Experience with document processing and data extraction pipelines.

- Experience with GraphQL apis.

- You have a sharp eye for UX/UI, and you work user-centered.

- Experience with different types of methodologies and tools for Unit, Integration and End to End testing.

- Have good communication in oral and written English.

- Experience working on agile and lean methodologies.

- Experience building and scaling complex, high-performance, high-transaction applications.


Benefits:


- Health and Dental Plan

- Individual Life Insurance

- Flexible Hours (in compliance with daily work hours)

- Flexible Meal/Food Allowance

- Home Office Support

- Furniture Assistance

- Psychological Support (for you or legal dependents)

- Wellhub

- Extended Maternity and Paternity Leave

- School/Nanny Allowance

- Supplemental Nutrition Assistance

- Veterinary Plan

- Birthday Day Off

- Marriage Leave (7 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Loved Ones (10 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Adoption or Pet Loss (2 days)

- Individual Funeral Assistance

- Monthly Education Support

- Payroll Loan

- Financial Consulting

- Udemy Corporate Access

- Coworking Space

- Pipefy License for up to 10 Users

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Desenvolvedor IA
description:
Somos uma empresa do Grupo Stefanini. Especializados em marketing digital, utilizamos uma abordagem integrada que combina tecnologia, inteligência de dados, design e profundo conhecimento do comportamento do consumidor. Nosso foco está em potencializar os resultados de nossos parceiros, oferecendo soluções que vão desde consultoria estratégica até a execução e acompanhamento dos projetos. Com um time dedicado e altamente qualificado, a Gauge se destaca por sua capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas de cada cliente e entregar resultados de alta performance.

Com forte presença na América Latina e em expansão nos Estados Unidos, estamos sempre na vanguarda, aplicando as últimas tendências de mercado e mantendo um olhar atento à inovação contínua.


DESENVOLVEDOR IA


Como Desenvolvedor Sr / Especialista de IA “Hands On”, você atuará em parceria com a equipe de desenvolvimento, não apenas liderando, mas também contribuindo ativamente para a codificação e implementação de soluções inovadoras. Sua experiência técnica e sua paixão pela IA serão essenciais para guiar o time na criação de soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho.



Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de software utilizando tecnologias de inteligência artificial.
  • Trabalhar com algoritmos e técnicas específicas de IA, incluindo NLP e aprendizado de máquina.
  • Implementar soluções de IA utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Utilizar frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain, para desenvolver soluções escaláveis.
  • Implementar soluções de NLP com ferramentas como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Realizar pré-processamento de texto, incluindo tokenização, criação de embeddings e remoção de stop words.
  • Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Porte (LLMs), como GPT e Llama, aplicando melhores práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolver aplicações web utilizando frameworks como FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Colaborar na implementação de soluções utilizando MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para a implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Participar de processos de HAG (Hiper-Agilidade) para garantir entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Integrar e otimizar embeddings para melhorar a performance das soluções de IA.
  • Mentorizar e apoiar os membros da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado e colaboração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência com N8N é obrigatória.
  • Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e otimização de embeddings.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de software para aplicações de inteligência artificial.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js ou Go.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain.
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de NLP, como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experiência em pré-processamento de texto e implementação de LLMs.
  • Vivência em arquiteturas de software escaláveis e de alto desempenho voltadas para IA.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web com FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Experiência com MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe e boa comunicação.
